source: Live recording from DeepSeek (deepseek-flash) through its Anthropic-format API, 2026-09-30.

content.text: My place tools are down right now, so I can't check tomorrow's prices or availability at Karsa Spa — and I can't hold spots at all, since only a person can confirm a booking. From the web, Bali.live lists a 60-minute Balinese massage at 180,000 IDR and a 90-minute at 250,000 IDR, but that's a published price, not tomorrow's, and it's a site I can't verify against the spa itself. Best move is to message them directly and ask about tomorrow afternoon — want me to draft that note for you?
